title: fix(pm): an accepted relay dispatch with no run is UNCONFIRMED under auto too, never a direct write
body:
Fixes #21892

Clause-②: no

## What changes

After a relay dispatch the platform ACCEPTED (HTTP 204), "no run appeared within the start window" — or a run that never completed — is now answered **UNCONFIRMED** by every relay sender: exit 6, the shared `unconfirmedText` sentence (go READ the card, never re-run blind), under `auto` exactly as under an explicit `dispatch`. No sender takes a direct write after an accepted dispatch any more, so a relay that is merely queued can no longer turn into a write under the seat's personal login (and a second write when the queued run executes). `OS_FLEET_TRANSPORT=direct` stays the only way to write as the personal account; the route-selection read (condition ③ in `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`: the workflow file's 404, `disabled_manually`) is unchanged.

| sender | on `main` (`3d9188502e`) under `auto` + `no-run` | on this branch |
|---|---|---|
| `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` | `fallbackText(...)` then the direct additive POST/DELETE | exit 6, zero requests after the pre-read |
| `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs` | `fallbackText(...)` then the direct POST | exit 6, zero requests |
| `scripts/pm/issue-transfer.mjs` | `fallbackText(...)` then the direct GraphQL mutation | exit 6, zero requests after the pre-read |
| `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` | `fallbackText(...)` then the direct comment POST / body PATCH | exit 6, zero requests |
| `scripts/pm/close-cards.mjs` | already exit 6, no direct fall-back | unchanged; carries the conformance probe |

`fallbackText` is deleted from `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`: after the change it has no caller anywhere in the tree (`git grep -n fallbackText` at `776ab7f2ff`: 0 hits; `with-fleet.sh` never called it — its `auto` asks `dispatch.mjs --route` before anything is sent, and an actions file goes to this file's CLI, which has no direct path).

## The enumeration pin (the triage grade's "a tool added later fails the pin")

`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --self-test` gains one battery, **the no-run conformance** (27 cases, floor 18 batteries):

- the senders are DISCOVERED from source on every run — every code file under `scripts/` except `dispatch.mjs` that names `sendFleetWrite` — with a by-name floor of today's five, so a scan gone blind reds;
- each sender must export `relayMissProbe({ route, send, pace })`: ONE write through its real write path against its own offline fake platform. A sender without it fails the pin;
- each is driven through the REAL `sendFleetWrite` over a fake platform with an accepted (204) dispatch and (a) no run under `auto`, (b) no run under explicit `dispatch`, (c) a run that never completes under `auto`. Each must answer exit 6, after exactly ONE dispatch, with ZERO direct writes (any request but GET/HEAD), printing the shared UNCONFIRMED sentence;
- the control drives each probe under `direct`: its write is issued directly and seen by the recorder, and nothing is dispatched — so the empty lists above are a measurement;
- `dispatch.mjs`'s own CLI answers the same (exit 6, one dispatch, no other write).

The per-tool pins that said "auto falls back only on no-run" are flipped in `label-write`, `issue-create` and `issue-transfer` to exit 6 **and** the exact request list after the dispatch (pre-read only, or none); `close-cards` already pinned it. `post-stamped`'s self-test is synchronous, so its behavioural pin is the conformance; its own gate now also carries the structural half (main writes only through `writeThroughRoute`, whose one direct write sits on the non-dispatch branch ahead of the relay, and whose no-run/timeout branch returns UNCONFIRMED). CI runs the dispatcher self-test on every PR (the `Fleet-write dispatcher self-test` step in `lint.yml` carries no `if:`).

## Ablation — both directions, at `776ab7f2ff`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, blob must change, restore proven)

| leg | mutation | own self-test | dispatcher self-test |
|---|---|---|---|

| B | label-write stops exporting `relayMissProbe` | exit 0 (the export is the conformance's door, not label-write's) | exit 1: `exports relayMissProbe` got `"undefined"`; battery floor 23 below 27 |
| C | label-write re-opens `auto` + `no-run` → direct | exit 1: 2 cases, calls `[GET issues/7, POST issues/7/labels, GET issues/7]` | exit 1: `label-write.mjs: auto + … + no-run` got `[0,1,204,"no-run",["POST …/issues/7/labels"],false]` |

Every leg restored: blob equals `HEAD` (`post-stamped.mjs` `f51c37c8f5`, `label-write.mjs` `b364caeacc`), `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, `git status --porcelain` empty. The green direction is the same commands on the restored tree (the self-test block above). The first attempt of legs A and C was refused by `ablation-replace` (the replacement still contained the anchor, "the anchor count moved 1 to 1") — no command ran, not a measurement; both were re-anchored and re-run.

- Lint, a declared narrowing: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the six files — 6 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings (none reported as ignored). Population: `eslint.config.mjs`'s `**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}` block covers `scripts/pm/*.mjs`. Invariance: the config never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, said in its own header) and its plugin rules are per-file, so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- The local derivation for a diff touching only `post-stamped.mjs` names `check:pm-post-stamped` but not `check:pm-fleet-write-dispatch`, where the conformance lives; CI runs the dispatcher self-test unconditionally, and post-stamped's own gate now carries the structural half. Noted, not filed (the derivation script is frozen).
- `post-stamped.mjs`'s size route (a body over the relay's 60,000-byte cap under `auto` goes direct for that write, with one line naming bytes, cap and identity) is a pre-dispatch, declared and pinned route decision, untouched here. It sits beside the grade's sentence that `OS_FLEET_TRANSPORT=direct` stays the only way to write as the personal account; whether that sentence covers it is a ruling, not this card. Noted, not filed.
- #19774 is the route-selection half of this class and is not touched; #19990, #21294, #22052 and #22053 remain open and are not addressed here.
